- Approve the proposed staging window (two-day soak + 4-hour cutover window)

- Week 0: capacity attestation + load profile validation (Helios + Redwood)
- Week 1: staging run (dedicated pool) + regression checks
- Week 2: production swap low-traffic window + post-cutover verification

If you can confirm the attestation items by EOD Tuesday we can lock the staging cluster and reserve the GPU pool for the requested dates.

Thanks,

Vanessa — tagging infra and solutions. I ran a quick right-size calc using Sophie’s peak QPS and our standard per-request token mix. Summary:

- Baseline units required (p99 SLO target): 6 A100-80GB equivalents (continuous)
- With 20% headroom requested: provision 8 A100-80GB equivalents
- Expected aggregate throughput (8 units): ~700 req/s sustained at p99 latency < 1.1s

Notes / assumptions:
- We assume request concurrency profile matches your staging traces (attached calculation sheet). If their median payload grows >25% we should revisit quantization profiles.
- KV cache warmup: expect increased tail latencies for first ~30 minutes of a traffic pattern change; recommend a 2-hour pre-warm soak during staging.

Action items for Redwood infra:
- Reserve 8 GPUs in Dedicated pool for the candidate staging week (request to Capacity team).
- Provide a reproducible load script and seed trace (I can bake this into our stress harness).

I'll attach the calc export to the milestone sheet and drop the load script in the shared plan.

-Karthik

Proposed staging + cutover windows:
- Staging soak: Thu 2026-11-12 00:00 - Fri 2026-11-13 23:59 PT (48h soak, limited to Helios test tokens)
- Blue/Green cutover candidate: Tue 2026-11-17 02:00 - 06:00 PT (4-hour window)
- Fallback hold: next 6h where we keep hosted fallback routing active

Operational checklist (pre-cutover):
- Capacity reservation confirmed (8 A100-80GB equiv) — ACTION: capacity@redwood to ACK by 2026-11-05
- Model quantization profile pinned to v2 (tested in staging) — ACTION: Model oncall to snapshot
- Prefix/KV cache snapshot + pre-warm script — ACTION: Karthik to deliver by Nov 9
- Observability: token-level tracing and per-route SLO dashboards configured — ACTION: Sean to validate alerts

Risk notes:
- Quantization regressions: run downgrade plan to float32 variant as fallback (adds latency but preserves correctness).
- Cross-tenant GPU noisy-neighbor: use dedicated pool + tenant isolation; monitor util and autoscale threshold.

I’ll prepare a short runbook (playbook steps + rollback triggers) and attach to the shared migration-plan link.
